description: Works to trees covered by LBE ORDER NO 15 (4) 1971: PROPOSAL A - 1x Holly (T3) crown lift to 3m above ground level, retain shrub below. PROPOSAL B - 1x Yew (T1) - crown lift to 2.4m above ground level, reduce lateral growth from boundary wall by up to 2m, shape remainder, 1x Holly (T3) - crown reduce by up to 2m, cutting back to a side branch and leaving a flowing branch line without stumps, 1x Ash (T4) - crown lift to 3m above ground level, retain lower secondary stem, crown reduce by up to 3m cutting back to a side branch and leaving a flowing branch line without stumps, shorten lateral growth and shape by 2m, remove deadwood.
